newsitem.title: USA: AFC Cable files for two million common.
newsitem.headline: AFC Cable files for two million common.

text.p: AFC Cable Systems Inc Friday filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Comission to sell up to two million common shares.
Of the total amount, 1.2 million common are being offered by the company and 800,000 common are being sold by selling shareholders. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 8,760,909 common.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common. The offering will be made through Tucker Anthony Inc, Robert Baird & Co Inc and Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc. Proceeds will be used for investment in additional plant and production equipment to expand manufacturing capacity, repayment of certain indebtedness and general corporate purposes, including potential acquisitions, AFC said.

AFC, based in Providence, R.I., is a designer, manufacturer and supplier of electrical, voice and data distribution products used primarily in the construction and modernization of non-residential buildings.
